CustomField.formula: IF( LEN(TEXT(VALUE(MID(TEXT(Start_Date_Time__c), 12, 2)))) = 1, "0" & TEXT(VALUE(MID(TEXT(Start_Date_Time__c), 12, 2))), TEXT(VALUE(MID(TEXT(Start_Date_Time__c), 12, 2))) ) & ":" & IF( LEN(TEXT(VALUE(MID(TEXT(Start_Date_Time__c), 15, 2)))) = 1, "0" & TEXT(VALUE(MID(TEXT(Start_Date_Time__c), 15, 2))), TEXT(VALUE(MID(TEXT(Start_Date_Time__c), 15, 2))) ) & ":" & IF( LEN(TEXT(VALUE(MID(TEXT(Start_Date_Time__c), 18, 2)))) = 1, "0" & TEXT(VALUE(MID(TEXT(Start_Date_Time__c), 18, 2))), TEXT(VALUE(MID(TEXT(Start_Date_Time__c), 18, 2))) ) & " " & CASE(TimeZone__c, "Asia/Singapore", "SGT", "Australia/Sydney", "AEDT", "Asia/Dubai", "GST", "Asia/Kolkata", "IST", "GMT", "GMT", "Unknown")
CustomField.label: Start Time Format
